etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Late Latin peiōrātus (“worsened”, past participle of peiōrāre (“worsen”), from Latin peior (“worse”)) +‎ -ive. Compare French péjoratif (“depreciative, disparaging”). By surface analysis, pejorate +‎ -ive.
senses: A disparaging, belittling, or derogatory word or expression.
